title: Go SDK: typed struct field tags, generic decoder helpers, and streaming ergonomics with example harness
creator: Avery Chen
description: Implement a set of idiomatic Go SDK helpers focused on: (1) strictly-typed struct models for structured outputs with clear tags and optional stream metadata; (2) a small set of generics-based Decode[T] utilities and decoder combinators to turn streaming tokens/events into typed results; (3) streaming ergonomics for users (context cancellation, backpressure, incremental decode callbacks); and (4) end-to-end example harnesses demonstrating chat and embeddings workflows with retries and schema validation.
acceptance_criteria: Provide typed struct examples for common Redwood responses (ChatMessage, EmbeddingVector, RerankItem) with recommended tags and validation docstring comments.
Expose a generic Decode[T](stream Reader, opts...) helper that returns either T or a deterministic error for schema mismatches.
Add StreamDecoder combinators (Map, Filter, Fold) that work with generics and support early termination via context.
Retries: include example retry middleware for transient stream errors and ensure idempotency guidance is documented.
Publish 2 consumer-facing examples: chat-with-structured-actions and embedding-batch-with-backoff. Each example must be runnable and linked from the README.
Unit tests covering decoder success, schema mismatch, partial-stream-resume, and retry backoff behavior. CI must pass on linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
Docs: PR with API reference + migration notes for existing SDK users; internal design doc linked.

implementation_summary: Key pieces: (A) typed model definitions with clear JSON tags and minimal custom unmarshallers for fields that require tolerant parsing (timestamps, optional numeric IDs); (B) DecodeOne[T] that reads a stream until a terminal JSON object is produced and unmarshals to T using encoding/json with optional validation hook; (C) StreamInto[T] which yields typed partial updates via a channel and respects context cancellation/backpressure; (D) internal decoder combinators used by StreamInto for performance in hot paths; (E) retry helper that wraps StreamInto with configurable idempotency key and exponential backoff for transient EOF/503s.
